note: Frozen row list of the harness atlas. 22 core facets, each with named sub-feature rows, plus the unmapped bucket U00. Every row has a cell in every column. Comparison claims are made only on a named row (plan, Design, Facet taxonomy and frozen rows). Extended on 2026-10-05, by owner decision, with facet F23 (six rows) to cover the steps the lifecycle layer listed as not yet researched. lever: the lever class a row belongs to, or null. slice: P5 rows are researched first, for the lever guide and the routing-matrix precursor.

facets.name: Loop and built-in tools
facets.definition: The agent loop shape and the native tool inventory.

rows.label: Loop shape
rows.definition: How a turn runs: plan, tool call, result, stop.

rows.label: Turn and step limits
rows.definition: Caps on turns, steps or tokens per run, and stop conditions.

rows.label: Native tool inventory
rows.definition: The built-in tools the agent can call.

rows.label: Shell execution tool
rows.definition: How commands run: shell, working directory, timeouts, output handling.

rows.label: File read, edit and write tools
rows.definition: Native file tools and how edits are applied.

rows.label: Web search and fetch tools
rows.definition: Built-in web search or page fetch, and their controls.

facets.name: Context and memory
facets.definition: Window management, compaction, persistent or auto memory.

rows.label: Context window size
rows.definition: Window sizes available and how to choose one.

rows.label: Automatic compaction
rows.definition: When and how history is summarized without a command.

rows.label: Manual compaction
rows.definition: A user command or setting that compacts or clears context.

rows.label: Context inclusion controls
rows.definition: Mentions, attachments, ignore files and what enters the window.

rows.label: Persistent memory
rows.definition: Memory that survives sessions: files, notes or an auto-memory store.

rows.label: Memory scope and loading
rows.definition: Where memory lives, who sees it, and when it is loaded.

facets.name: Instruction files
facets.definition: Auto-loaded instruction files, import syntax, precedence.

rows.label: Auto-loaded files
rows.definition: File names loaded without being asked (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, rules).

rows.label: Import syntax
rows.definition: How one instruction file pulls in another.

rows.label: Precedence and scoping
rows.definition: Which file wins and how directories nest.

rows.label: Path-scoped rules
rows.definition: Rules that apply only to matching paths or file types.

rows.label: User and project scope
rows.definition: Personal versus repository instruction locations.

facets.name: Permission engine
facets.definition: Allow, deny and ask rules, scopes, precedence and prompt behaviour.

rows.label: Approval modes
rows.definition: Named levels of how much the agent may do without asking.

rows.label: Per-tool rules
rows.definition: Allow, ask or deny a named tool.

rows.label: Path scoping
rows.definition: Rules limited to files or directories.

rows.label: Command scoping
rows.definition: Rules limited to shell command patterns.

rows.label: Trust prompt
rows.definition: The first-run or per-folder trust decision.

rows.label: Bypass mode
rows.definition: A mode or flag that skips permission prompts.

rows.label: Auto review
rows.definition: A model or classifier that approves or denies actions instead of the user.

rows.label: Config scope and precedence
rows.definition: Where permission rules live and which scope wins.

facets.name: Sandbox and network isolation
facets.definition: OS sandbox, container or VM isolation, network allow-lists.

rows.label: OS or container sandbox
rows.definition: The isolation mechanism around commands or the whole agent.

rows.label: Filesystem write scope
rows.definition: Where the agent may write.

rows.label: Network policy
rows.definition: Allowed hosts, proxies and offline modes.

rows.label: Subprocess containment
rows.definition: Whether child processes inherit the restrictions.

rows.label: Sandbox override
rows.definition: How a command runs outside the sandbox, and who may allow it.

facets.name: Hooks and lifecycle events
facets.definition: Event catalog, handler types, contract, blocking semantics.

rows.label: Event catalog
rows.definition: The lifecycle events a hook can attach to.

rows.label: Handler types
rows.definition: Command, HTTP, prompt or agent handlers.

rows.label: Input contract
rows.definition: What a hook receives: fields, format, channel.

rows.label: Output and blocking semantics
rows.definition: Exit codes or JSON that allow, deny, ask or modify.

rows.label: Matcher semantics
rows.definition: How a hook selects the tool or event it fires on.

rows.label: Configuration locations
rows.definition: Files, scopes and plugin-provided hooks.

rows.label: Trust and enable controls
rows.definition: How hooks are trusted, reviewed, disabled or locked by policy.

facets.name: Managed and enterprise controls
facets.definition: Org policy, admin settings, data retention, identity.

rows.label: Managed settings delivery
rows.definition: How an admin pushes settings: file, server or MDM.

rows.label: Policy lockdown
rows.definition: Settings or features an admin can force or disable.

rows.label: Model allow and deny lists
rows.definition: Admin control over which models may be used.

rows.label: Identity and SSO
rows.definition: Sign-in methods, SSO and seat management.

rows.label: Data retention and privacy

rows.label: Admin audit and reporting

rows.label: Per-skill tool and model overrides

rows.label: Definition format
rows.definition: File layout and frontmatter fields of a custom agent.

rows.label: Tool allow-list
rows.definition: How an agent's tools are restricted.

rows.label: Per-agent model

rows.label: Per-agent effort

rows.label: Nesting rules

facets.name: Slash and custom commands

rows.label: Built-in commands

rows.label: Custom command format
rows.definition: File layout and frontmatter of a user command.

rows.label: Arguments

rows.label: Discovery paths
rows.definition: Where custom commands are found, by scope.

rows.label: Relation to skills

facets.name: Plugins and marketplaces

rows.label: Component types

rows.label: Install sources

rows.label: Versioning and update

rows.label: Trust and signing

facets.name: MCP

rows.label: Transports

rows.label: Config location and scope

rows.label: Authentication

rows.label: Tool filtering and naming

facets.name: Sessions, checkpoints, rewind

rows.label: Resume and continue

rows.label: Fork or branch a session
rows.definition: Starting a new line from an existing session.

rows.label: Checkpoint and rewind
rows.definition: Undoing edits or conversation to an earlier point.

rows.label: Transcript storage
rows.definition: Where session history is stored and in what format.

rows.label: Session naming and listing
rows.definition: Finding and naming sessions.

rows.label: Cross-surface handoff

facets.name: Worktrees and parallel execution

rows.label: Worktree isolation

rows.label: Concurrency caps

rows.label: Parallel subagents
rows.definition: Running several subagents in one turn.

rows.label: Total agent caps
rows.definition: Limits on the total agents or calls in a run.

rows.label: Multi-session coordination

facets.name: Background, scheduled and cloud-delegated work
facets.definition: Background tasks, routines, cloud agents, delegation.

rows.label: Background tasks
rows.definition: Commands or agents that keep running while you work.

rows.label: Scheduled routines
rows.definition: Recurring or one-off scheduled runs.

rows.label: Cloud agents
rows.definition: Agents that run on the vendor's machines.

rows.label: Remote sessions
rows.definition: Driving a session running elsewhere.

rows.label: Event triggers
rows.definition: Webhooks, PR events or messages that start a run.

rows.label: Delegation to other agents
rows.definition: Handing work to another harness or agent product.

facets.name: Surfaces and programmatic control
facets.definition: CLI, IDE, desktop, web, cloud, headless, SDK, CI.

rows.label: Interactive CLI
rows.definition: The terminal interface.

rows.label: Headless mode
rows.definition: Non-interactive runs and output formats.

rows.label: IDE integration
rows.definition: Editor extensions and their relation to the CLI.

rows.label: Desktop and web apps
rows.definition: Standalone apps and browser surfaces.

rows.label: SDK and API
rows.definition: Libraries or APIs to drive the agent.

rows.label: CI and chat surfaces

facets.name: Model selection and routing

rows.label: Flag, setting and environment

rows.label: Automatic routing
rows.definition: The product choosing or switching models itself.

rows.label: Providers and bring-your-own-key
rows.definition: Other providers, gateways and custom endpoints.

rows.label: Model catalog and availability
rows.definition: Which models exist, by plan and surface.

facets.name: Reasoning effort and thinking
facets.definition: Controls, allowed values, per-agent override.

rows.label: Effort values and defaults
rows.definition: The allowed levels and the default.

rows.label: Where effort is set
rows.definition: Flag, setting, environment, command or UI.

rows.label: Model dependence
rows.definition: Which levels each model accepts.

rows.label: Thinking budget and visibility
rows.definition: Token budgets and whether reasoning is shown.

facets.name: Modes and autonomy levels
facets.definition: Named modes, how each is entered, what each changes.

rows.label: Named modes
rows.definition: The modes the product defines.

rows.label: How modes are entered
rows.definition: Keys, flags, commands or settings that switch mode.

rows.label: Plan mode
rows.definition: A read-only planning mode, and how it exits.

rows.label: Auto-accept and autonomous modes
rows.definition: Modes that act without per-step approval.

rows.label: Read-only or ask mode
rows.definition: A mode that cannot change files.

rows.label: Mode defaults and persistence
rows.definition: The default mode and whether a choice persists.

facets.name: Version, release channel, update path
facets.definition: Version at retrieval, cadence, channel, changelog.

rows.label: Version at retrieval
rows.definition: The current version on the retrieval date, and its source.

rows.label: Release channels
rows.definition: Stable, preview or nightly tracks.

rows.label: Update mechanism
rows.definition: How the product updates itself or is updated.

rows.label: Changelog source
rows.definition: Where release notes live and their format.

rows.label: Deprecation policy
rows.definition: How removals and renames are announced.

facets.name: Relationship to host platform
facets.definition: What the surface runs on and what it shares with its siblings.

rows.label: Host platform
rows.definition: The platform this surface runs on.

rows.label: Shared account and billing
rows.definition: Whether account and billing are shared with a sibling.

rows.label: Shared execution infrastructure
rows.definition: Whether machines or VMs are shared with a sibling.

rows.label: Shared model selection
rows.definition: Whether model choice is made by the same system.

rows.label: Shared agent runtime
rows.definition: Whether the agent loop is the same code as a sibling's.

rows.label: Delegates to
rows.definition: Which other surface it hands work to.

rows.label: Distinct harness features
rows.definition: Documented features that no sibling has.

facets.name: Usage, cost, limits and observability
facets.definition: Usage and cost visibility, budgets, rate limits, telemetry, logs.

rows.label: Usage and cost visibility
rows.definition: Where a user sees tokens or spend.

rows.label: Budgets and caps
rows.definition: Spend or token limits a user or admin can set.

rows.label: Rate-limit behaviour
rows.definition: Plan limits, windows and what happens at the limit.

rows.label: Telemetry and OpenTelemetry
rows.definition: Metrics and traces the harness emits.

rows.label: Logs and debug output
rows.definition: Log files and debug switches.

rows.label: Status line and display
rows.definition: On-screen status of model, cost and context.

facets.name: Request and response handling
facets.definition: What the harness does around each model call: how the request is assembled, cached and retried, and how the model's tool calls and the tool results are checked and limited.

rows.label: Prompt assembly
rows.definition: What goes into each model request and in what order (system prompt, instruction files, tool definitions, history, attachments), and what a user can see or change.

rows.label: Prompt caching
rows.definition: Whether the harness reuses the unchanged start of a prompt across turns, how long it is kept, what invalidates it, and any setting to turn it on, off or tune it.

rows.label: Retry and back-off
rows.definition: What the harness does when a model call fails or is throttled: automatic retries, waiting, limits on attempts, and the message shown.

rows.label: Malformed call recovery
rows.definition: What happens when the model asks for a tool that does not exist, gives invalid arguments or returns output that cannot be parsed: error returned to the model, retry or stop.

rows.label: Tool output limits
rows.definition: Limits on how much tool output enters the context and how it is cut (truncated, summarized or saved to a file), and any setting that changes them.

rows.label: Output redaction
rows.definition: Whether secrets or sensitive text are removed from tool output, transcripts, logs or telemetry, and how.

optional_facets.name: Editor and LSP integration
optional_facets.definition: Diagnostics, selection context, IDE protocol. Researched where the corpus speaks to it; a missing cell renders as not researched.

unmapped.name: Unmapped
unmapped.definition: Documented features that fit no frozen row. Each record keeps its quote, is listed on the sources pages and never counts toward complete. Three or more records across two or more columns become an owner Update item.
